title: Foggy night encounter with a scout craft piloted by a young lady
summary: Charles Hall tells of Foggy night encounter with a scout craft piloted by a young lady, about 1960s at Indian Springs Valley, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: on one cold and snowy night in the fall back in the 60s when I damn near died in the fog and the scout craft with the l young lady in it and some of her friends accompanied by the deep spacecraft and the teenage craft.

plain: Charles Hall, who says he lived near tall white beings in the Nevada desert, tells of a cold, snowy, foggy night in the fall sometime in the 1960s in Indian Springs Valley, Nevada. He says he nearly died in the fog and met a small "scout craft" flown by a young woman of those beings and some of her friends, with larger craft he calls the deep spacecraft and the teenage craft nearby.
